ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'InwTwr_DeleteTwrPartie' AND type = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.InwTwr_DeleteTwrPartie

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.InwTwr_DeleteTwrPartie ON CDN.InwTwr FOR DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON
IF exists (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('[WMS].[Features_CheckIfLotIsUsedInWmsIF]') AND Type = 'IF') DELETE CDN.TwrPartie FROM deleted join CDN.TwrPartie ON deleted.Int_TpaID = CDN.TwrPartie.Tpa_ID WHERE TPa_WMS = 0 and not exists (select dst_gidnumer from cdn.dostawy where Dst_TPaId = cdn.TwrPartie.TpA_Id) and not exists (select * from cdn.InwTwr where InT_TpaID = cdn.TwrPartie.Tpa_Id) and not exists (select mae_tpaid from cdn.magelem where mae_TPaId = cdn.twrpartie.TpA_Id) and (select [Value] FROM [WMS].[Features_CheckIfLotIsUsedInWmsIF](CDN.twrpartie.TpA_Id))=0
ELSE IF exists (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('[WMS].[Features_CheckIfLotIsUsedInWms]') AND Type = 'FN') DELETE CDN.TwrPartie FROM deleted join CDN.TwrPartie ON deleted.Int_TpaID = CDN.TwrPartie.Tpa_ID WHERE TPa_WMS = 0 and not exists (select dst_gidnumer from cdn.dostawy where Dst_TPaId = cdn.TwrPartie.TpA_Id) and not exists (select * from cdn.InwTwr where InT_TpaID = cdn.TwrPartie.Tpa_Id) and not exists (select mae_tpaid from cdn.magelem where mae_TPaId = cdn.twrpartie.TpA_Id) and (select [WMS].[Features_CheckIfLotIsUsedInWms](CDN.twrpartie.TpA_Id))=0 ELSE DELETE CDN.TwrPartie FROM deleted join CDN.TwrPartie ON deleted.Int_TpaID = CDN.TwrPartie.Tpa_ID WHERE TPa_WMS = 0 and not exists (select dst_gidnumer from cdn.dostawy where Dst_TPaId = cdn.TwrPartie.TpA_Id) and not exists (select * from cdn.InwTwr where InT_TpaID = cdn.TwrPartie.Tpa_Id) and not exists (select mae_tpaid from cdn.magelem where mae_TPaId = cdn.twrpartie.TpA_Id)
SET NOCOUNT OFF
